merger_description:
Respect Group Limited (**Respect Group**) proposes to acquire 100% of the business, business assets, and land owned by Proserpine Nursing Home Inc (**Proserpine****Nursing Home**) (the **Acquisition**).

Respect Group is a not-for-profit registered charity and unlisted public company based in Tasmania, which provides residential aged care, retirement living, and support at home services focused on dignity and wellbeing for older adults. Respect Group owns and operates 41 residential aged care homes across Tasmania, New South Wales, Victoria, Western Australia, Queensland, and South Australia.

Proserpine Nursing Home is a not-for-profit incorporated association and registered charity operating a single-site residential aged care home with 104 beds at 42 Anzac Road, Proserpine, in the Whitsunday Region of Queensland.

Following completion, Respect Group will continue to operate Proserpine Nursing Home for the benefit of the Proserpine community and has agreed to invest in a significant refurbishment to the facility.

determination_table_content.details:
Respect Group Limited (Respect Group) applied for a notification
waiver in respect of its proposed acquisition of 100% of the
business, assets, and land of Prosperine Nursing Home Inc
(Proserpine Nursing Home), as described in the transaction
documents provided as part of the application (the Acquisition).

The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission has
determined under section 51ABV(1)(a) of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.

The acquirer, Respect Group, is a not-for-profit registered charity and
unlisted public company based in Tasmania, which provides
residential aged care, retirement living, and support at home services
focused on dignity and wellbeing for older adults. Respect Group
owns and operates 41 residential aged care homes across
Tasmania, New South Wales, Victoria, Western Australia,
Queensland, and South Australia.
The target, Prosperine Nursing Home, is a not-for-profit incorporated
association and registered charity operating a single-site residential
aged care home with 104 beds at 42 Anzac Road, Prosperine, in the
Whitsunday Region of Queensland.

In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application, and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information currently before it, the ACCC considers that
the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material lessening of
competition given:
a. there is limited geographic overlap between Respect Group
and Proserpine Nursing Home, with Respect Group’s closest
existing residential aged care facility being located
approximately 120 kilometres away by road
b. there are alternative providers of residential aged care
services in the region surrounding Proserpine Nursing
Home.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
